content:
As of June 2024, the **tallest building in the world** is the **Burj Khalifa** in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

- **Height:** 828 meters (2,717 feet)
- **Floors:** 163
- **Completion Year:** 2010

The Burj Khalifa has held the title of the world's tallest building since its completion, surpassing the previous record holder, the **Taipei 101** in Taiwan.

Other notable supertall skyscrapers include:
- **Merdeka 118** (Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia) – 678.9 meters (2,227 feet)
- **Shanghai Tower** (Shanghai, China) – 632 meters (2,073 feet)
- **Abraj Al-Bait Clock Tower** (Mecca, Saudi Arabia) – 601 meters (1,972 feet)

Would you like details on any other record-holding structures?
